description: Issue #857: re-adds [Public] (IAllowAnonymous) to the demo FileApiController's GetFileName action -- a compile-preserving attribute add, not a statement delete -- reproducing the pre-#830 state where any unauthenticated caller could read another tenant's FileAttachment name by GUID. This action's HTTP coverage was one of the four docs/production-readiness.md:67 claimed existed but did not: FileApiControllerHardeningTests830.cs had zero test methods for GetFileName before #857. Checked against the new GetFileName_Unauthenticated_RejectedAndDoesNotLeakContent_AuthenticatedSucceeds, which seeds a FileAttachment whose FILE NAME embeds a random marker and asserts both that an unauthenticated GET returns 401 AND that the response body never contains the marker.
target_symbol: FileApiController.GetFileName(WtmFileProvider,string,string) -- the [Public] attribute (absent after #830, this mutant re-adds it), line ~105
